contract_question: Is this proposition genuinely presented as a prospective decision, safety, stopping, rollback, threshold, or policy rule; are its trigger and prescribed action coherent; and does it avoid falsely presenting an authored normative choice as an empirically established fact?

claim.value: If H1 and H2 remain unresolved, measure R next; R1 favors H1 and R2 favors H2.

target.text: The unresolved export fault is either encoder omission (H1) or transport loss (H2), with equal prior odds. R is a calibrated per-request encoder-output trace compared with the final received inventory under fixed workload. R1 means the missing item never appears in that trace; R2 means it appears there but not in the final inventory. Trace completeness has been independently verified.

source_instrument.text: For this calibrated trace under fixed workload, P(R1|H1)=0.9 and P(R1|H2)=0.1; P(R2|H1)=0.1 and P(R2|H2)=0.9. Record one next trace using the verified logger without altering either path. These likelihoods license directional updating, not certainty.

mapping.text: The team proposes a single next measurement and gives its subordinate anticipated discrimination logic. No R outcome has yet been observed.
